scope: Immutable compact record of the completed frozen prompted COCO image-quality campaign. This is not full val2017 AP or arithmetic, performance, deployment, other-backend or video certification.
verification_scope: Selected document hashes and original report fields checked here; full export/report artifact closure and once-only attempts were checked by the bound final summary.

native_regressions.scope: Existing shape, stride, layout, placement, finite-output, boundary and native-path regression contracts.
native_regressions.quantized_matmul_limit: Existing scalar decoded-weight oracle: abs_error <= 0.025 + 0.005 * abs(expected). This is not the new linear-probe same-operands 2e-5 relative-L2 contract.

f16_codec.scope: Native F32/F16 cache conversion only; no complete model or W8A8/FP8 qualification

gguf_storage.scope: All declared GGUF payload/sidecar hashes, original checkpoint, tokenizer, tensor inventory, shape, layout, precision scope and fallback match; every quantized block independently decoded with pinned gguf-py and checked finite. No new arithmetic kernel or model-quality certification.

existing_f16_linear_probe.scope: Existing selected GGML F16 probe cases and expected rejection boundaries; not proof of every model operation or shape.

existing_cache_codec.scope: Recorded CPU AVX2 / CUDA fast-math encoder agreement and decoded payload/layout checks.
existing_cache_codec.limitation: CUDA Q8 expected encoded bytes use a bridge to the same pinned GGML CUDA encoder. This cannot establish an independent CUDA Q8 encoding proof.

fixed_model_regressions.scope: Fixed output regressions under their declared quality gates; not an independent arithmetic oracle.

excluded_paths.w8a8: No raw INT32 dot versus independent INT64 exact oracle or complete native image configuration.
excluded_paths.fp8: Existing arithmetic failures remain failures; not selected for final evaluation.
excluded_paths.bf16_w4a4_fp4: No complete implemented image configuration in this campaign.
